# Vello Agents

> Vello Agents (velloagents.com, formerly vello.gg) turns long videos into viral shorts and posts them daily. Paste a YouTube link: an agent finds the best moments, frames the speaker, adds captions, hooks, and music, and auto-posts vertical shorts to TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts. Creator agents run faceless channels that post every day on their own.

Not affiliated with Vello (vello.ai), an unrelated company.

## Products

- [Shorts Agent](https://velloagents.com/clipping): one long video in, captioned vertical shorts out, posted everywhere.
- [Creator Agents](https://velloagents.com/ai-influencer): faceless channels with their own persona, voice, and posting schedule.
- [Builder](https://velloagents.com/builder): set up an agent and its posting schedule.
- [Campaigns](https://velloagents.com/stage): brands pay per 1,000 verified views.
- [Pricing](https://velloagents.com/pricing): first 3 videos free.
